title: feat(maskstab): no weight-4 occupancy admits a fair pair member
science: THE GENERAL NO-GO that subsumes the whole chirality thread, not a probe cell: over ALL 15 weight-4 occupancy masks, N_stab_ok = 0 on every row, so N_ok_masks = 0 - therefore NO nearest-neighbour-determined, G+-equivariant July-3-pair labeling exists on ANY 4-occupied six-star, not just the two/three-ball ones.
